reason: A DSH Settings → Usage dashboard for monitoring DeepSeek balances, token consumption, costs, trends, and local API activity through official and locally estimated usage data.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 的 Settings → Usage 页面中监控 DeepSeek 余额、Token 用量、费用趋势和 API 活动。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Settings → Usage dashboard for monitoring DeepSeek balance, token usage, cost trends, and API activity.

capabilities: Reads configured DeepSeek API credentials to retrieve account balance and usage data
Retrieves official DeepSeek platform usage and cost records when a platform token is configured
Displays real-time local API activity metadata and usage trends
Opens the DeepSeek platform usage page
